To get the best result with the ark Tamo:

Install it on brick, concrete, blockwork, or flat stone to maintain its security rating.
If your wall is smooth render, use the XL Security Screws & Wall Plugs plus the matching fitting pack.
Do not install it on pebble dash.
Use the supplied template, not the key safe itself, when marking the holes.
Install it at least 6 inches away from any wall edge.
If you ever move it, use new fixings and drill new holes.

For daily use, make the most of the security by setting a strong code. The minimum is a 6 digit code with at least 2 digits repeated, and the recommended setup is an 8 digit code with at least one repeated number. Avoid obvious patterns like birth years, 2222, or 12345.
